summary_en: SBINM LLC, a wholly owned subsidiary of SBI Holdings, extended the tender offer period for BASE Inc. shares from September 30 to October 15, 2026 (30 business days total) at 340 yen per share. The settlement date was moved to October 22, 2026. Upon completion, SBINM will hold approximately 20.67% of BASE.
title_en: (Partial Amendment) Notice of Support for Tender Offer for BASE Inc. Shares by SBINM LLC (Wholly Owned Subsidiary of SBI Holdings) and Announcement of Capital and Business Alliance Agreement with SBI Holdings
translation_en_brief:
On September 30, 2026, BASE Inc. announced a partial amendment to its notice regarding a tender offer by SBINM LLC, a wholly owned subsidiary of SBI Holdings. The tender offer for BASE's ordinary shares at 340 yen per share, which began on August 31, 2026, has been extended. The offer period now runs through October 15, 2026, comprising 30 business days, compared to the original 20 business days ending September 30. Settlement is scheduled to commence on October 22, 2026.

Upon completion of the tender offer, SBINM will hold approximately 20.67% of BASE's voting rights, calculated based on the 1,151,009 total voting units as of June 30, 2026, disclosed in BASE's semi-annual report dated August 5, 2026. The tender offer aims to make BASE an equity method affiliate of SBI Holdings. The purchase ceiling remains 23,792,300 shares, with no minimum threshold specified. BASE's board supports the tender offer but remains neutral on whether shareholders should tender, leaving the decision to shareholders' discretion.
